name: Aitor Gonzalez-Agirre

affiliations.role: Lead of the Language Modelling team

bio: Aitor Gonzalez-Agirre leads the Language Modelling team in the Language Technologies Unit at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center. They are the first author of the Salamandra Technical Report, which describes open 2B, 7B and 40B parameter models trained on 35 European languages, and earlier co-authored the SemEval semantic textual similarity tasks.
known_for: First author of the Salamandra Technical Report
SemEval semantic textual similarity shared tasks
